# UFVP offline fixture

Eight unmodified Florida core rows at distinct published locations, extracted from
the official Florida Museum UFVP DwC-A v1.182 (published 2026-09-28, retrieved
2026-10-02). `eml.xml` and `meta.xml` are unmodified source metadata. The TSV core
was represented as JSON for deterministic tests. Tests make clearly fictional
mutations in memory to exercise missing, withheld and malformed values.

Source: Florida Museum of Natural History; Rachel Narducci.
University of Florida Vertebrate Paleontology.
[Official dataset](https://ipt.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/ipt/resource?r=ufvp&v=1.182).
[CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/): attribution and
noncommercial use required. This license applies to these data fixtures separately
